title: Avishkar OS Module Manifest
description: What a framework, agent, or shelf-package declares to register itself with the Core Engine's ModuleRegistry (see CONTRACT.md).

name.description: kebab-case, matches the module's directory name (STANDARDS.md SS3).

kind.description: framework = a factories/* entry or core/router; agent = a Chief Domain Agent under agents/; shelf-package = any other library-shelf item (a single MCP server, memory backend, etc.).

dependencies.description: Names of other registered modules this one depends on. Per ARCHITECTURE.md SS5, this must never include an application/product name -- the registry's dependency-direction check (see CONTRACT.md ModuleRegistry.register) rejects a manifest that violates this.
